{{Quote|In the end, a Jedi-led task force moved in to settle the matter. Trench's ship was destroyed, and we assumed he went down with it.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]|<ref name="Cat and Mouse">{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}}</ref>}}
'''Trench's flagship''' was commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] during his [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. It was destroyed in the [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|Battle of Malastare Narrows]] by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led task force.
